svg.title: How Ask Benchline answers a question
svg.desc: The browser posts a question to the ML service. A loop asks the model through LiteLLM, runs the read-only tools it asks for (benchmark, anomalies, equivalents), and streams every step back over Server-Sent Events. The panel shows thinking, each tool call and its result, then the answer with links to the item pages.
svg.text: one question in, every step streamed back
what the stream carries, in order
no done = a dropped stream: the panel says so and offers Retry
